author: p. j. laws
title: Linn County releases latest Week in Review newsletter for residents
text:
Linn County released its latest Week in Review newsletter on March 20, providing updates on county news, services, and recent Board of Supervisors meetings.
The newsletter aims to keep residents informed about important developments and encourage greater community engagement. According to the announcement, the Week in Review eNewsletter serves as a resource for staying updated on county news, services, events, and more.
Residents are encouraged to sign up to receive the Week in Review directly by email. The county also offers access to previous issues of the newsletter for those interested in reviewing past updates.
The ongoing publication of this newsletter reflects Linn County’s commitment to transparency and communication with its residents. By offering regular updates and recaps from official meetings, the county seeks to foster an informed and engaged community.
